India Proposes Insurance Reforms to Control Healthcare Expenses

India is planning insurance reforms aimed at curbing rising healthcare costs, according to sources cited by The Economic Times and The Hindu BusinessLine. The proposed measures are intended to manage expenses within the healthcare sector. Specific details of the reforms were not disclosed in the coverage.
